finding.title: The paper-named memory_training path has no reachable path history on main or feat/sciworld-support
finding.observation: GitHub's commits-by-path endpoint returns an empty list for opentinker/memory_training on both current main ancestry and the inspected feat/sciworld-support ancestry.
finding.scope_guard: This is ancestry/path-history evidence only for the two named refs. It does not rule out unmerged branches, rewritten/deleted unreachable commits, forks, author mirrors or non-GitHub source bundles.
